# 1000 Logos

> > Comprehensive database of famous company logos, brand symbols, and logo meanings across industries including software, sports, automotive, gaming, and fashion.

1000 Logos serves as a visual encyclopedia documenting brand identities, logo histories, and design evolution of companies worldwide. The site features curated collections organized by industry, interactive quizzes, and detailed analyses of logo redesigns and brand symbols from Nike and WNBA to automotive brands and gaming studios.

## Industry Logo Galleries

- [Software logos](https://1000logos.net/software/): Software company logos and application symbols gallery with names
- [Games logos / Video game company logos](https://1000logos.net/games-logos/): Video game logos and gaming studio symbols gallery
- [Soccer logos / Football logos](https://1000logos.net/soccer/): Soccer and football team logos, club symbols gallery with names
- [Organization logos](https://1000logos.net/organization/): International organization logos and iconic symbols collection
